_metadata.description: SDA requirements mapped to literal PRD operational target IDs.

requirements.title: Declared dependency extraction
requirements.description: Parse scenario service metadata and extract declared resource and scenario dependencies.

validation.notes: Validates `.vrooli/service.json` resource and scenario dependency extraction for runtime health.

requirements.title: Retained non-import scenario signals
requirements.description: Retain supported Vrooli command and workflow usage signals until AST facts replace them.

validation.notes: Interface graph tests cover non-import evidence preservation where upstream facts provide it.

requirements.title: Dependency metadata storage
requirements.description: Persist history-bearing dependency metadata and analysis records in the domain store.

validation.notes: Store tests validate dependency metadata persistence surfaces.

requirements.title: Interactive dependency graph UI
requirements.description: Render graph data with operator controls, status states, and selected-node details.

validation.notes: UI tests and type checks cover graph and governance operator surfaces.

requirements.title: Semantic scenario matching
requirements.description: Use Qdrant and embeddings for proposed-scenario similarity with deterministic fallback behavior.

validation.notes: Proposal tests validate semantic matching and deterministic fallback behavior.

requirements.title: CLI graph access
requirements.description: Expose graph, drift, optimization, export, health, and governance workflows through the SDA CLI.

validation.notes: CLI package tests and CLI Health discovery validate command availability.

requirements.title: API graph access
requirements.description: Serve REST and Connect endpoints for dependency and graph consumers.

validation.notes: Graph API tests validate downstream graph access.

requirements.title: Actual interface graph
requirements.description: Compute actual scenario edges from proto-health and code-facts batch facts.

validation.notes: Interface graph tests validate upstream proto/import fact interpretation.

requirements.title: Dependency drift reporting
requirements.description: Compare actual import evidence with declared scenario dependencies using asymmetric severity.

validation.notes: Dependency health maturity coverage includes graph drift rule families.

requirements.title: Connect graph seam
requirements.description: Expose DescribeInterfaceGraph as the reusable Connect contract for downstream planners.

validation.notes: Graph Connect handler tests validate the reusable graph seam.

requirements.title: SQLite storage cutover
requirements.description: Run SDA on SQLite with embedded domain-owned schemas and no Postgres runtime dependency.

validation.notes: Store tests validate SQLite-backed SDA persistence.

requirements.title: Test Genie dependency producer
requirements.description: Provide the single read-only SDA health producer consumed by Test Genie's dependencies phase.

validation.notes: Test Genie maps the SDA health response without native dependency fallback.

requirements.title: Dependency surface readiness
requirements.description: Discover dependency surfaces through Code Facts and validate commands, runtimes, modules, package managers, lockfiles, and local install state without mutating files.

validation.notes: Readiness routes by discovered surface language and checks Go/Node surface state.

requirements.title: Runtime dependency health
requirements.description: Report required resources and scenario dependencies from `.vrooli/service.json` with degraded runtime status evidence.

validation.notes: Runtime health reports required resource and scenario failures.

requirements.title: Approved dependency governance
requirements.description: Maintain reviewable approved-dependency governance memory for package choices, ranges, constraints, and non-allowlist guidance.

validation.notes: Governance tests validate review findings and advisory policy behavior.

requirements.title: Release-age policy validation
requirements.description: Validate pnpm `minimumReleaseAge` policy and governed release-age exceptions for dependency supply-chain safety.

validation.notes: Release-age tests validate missing and low pnpm policy findings.
Release-age tests validate governed exclusion handling.

requirements.title: Security evidence boundary
requirements.description: Report Security Health dependency-index context in dependency health while keeping vulnerability findings in Security Health and governance evidence workflows.

validation.notes: Dependency health does not call vulnerability evidence or emit security findings.
Governance still consumes Security Health vulnerability evidence.
Governance evidence parsing tolerates Security Health CLI wrapper output without moving scanner ownership into SDA.

requirements.title: Optimization recommendations
requirements.description: Recommend resource swaps and dependency reductions for lighter deployments.

validation.notes: Optimization tests validate recommendation behavior.

requirements.title: Dependency impact analysis
requirements.description: Explain which scenarios or resources are affected if a dependency is removed.

validation.notes: Add automated impact-analysis validation when OT-P1-002 implementation begins.

requirements.title: Dependency history
requirements.description: Track dependency changes over time for regression and trend analysis.

validation.notes: Add automated history validation when OT-P1-003 implementation begins.

requirements.title: Graph export formats
requirements.description: Export dependency graphs as JSON, DOT/GraphViz, and image-ready data.

validation.notes: Graph tests validate exportable graph payloads.

requirements.title: Cycle detection
requirements.description: Detect circular scenario or resource dependency chains.

validation.notes: Add automated cycle detection validation when OT-P1-005 implementation begins.

requirements.title: Resource cost estimation
requirements.description: Estimate resource cost and deployment weight from dependency depth and resource classes.

validation.notes: Add automated cost-estimation validation when OT-P1-006 implementation begins.

requirements.title: Governance operator workflow
requirements.description: Provide CLI and UI workflows for dependency governance triage, fleet validation, dry-run mutation, security-gap review, and remediation preview.

validation.notes: Governance UI tests validate triage, remediation, and dry-run/apply workflow copy.
Governance API tests validate fleet triage and security-gap workflow behavior.

requirements.title: Predictive dependency planning
requirements.description: Predict likely dependencies for new scenario proposals from similar historical scenarios.

validation.notes: Add automated predictive planning validation when OT-P2-001 implementation begins.

requirements.title: Refactoring suggestions
requirements.description: Suggest refactors that reduce dependency complexity or improve deployment modularity.

validation.notes: Add automated refactoring-suggestion validation when OT-P2-002 implementation begins.

requirements.title: CI dependency policy
requirements.description: Integrate with CI and quality loops to validate dependency changes before merge.

validation.notes: Add CI policy validation when OT-P2-003 implementation begins.
